role: A post-open p14 setup-equivalence and fresh-process resource gate for the independently validated v205 packed potential-normal representation. It is restricted to the all-nine arm for resource claims because the inherited five-camera accuracy gate failed. It is not fresh scientific validation, external generalization, curved-ray evidence, real BOST, paper success, or an algorithm breakthrough.
scientific_question: Can the v205 packed normal factor be built without ever materializing a global dense vector or potential response, and can the resulting all-nine compact K1 pipeline reduce fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline peak RSS relative to both the dense matched K1 control and the accepted dense K2 reference while preserving the frozen output?

data_isolation.trajectory_role: historically exposed development mechanism and resource audit
data_isolation.five_camera_resource_exclusion_reason: The independently sealed v199/v205 five-camera arm passed only 3/13 complete calibration groups, so it cannot support a matched-accuracy resource claim.
allowed_inputs: sealed v205 packed factors and coordinates only for post-construction equivalence comparison
forbidden_inputs: p14 truth field in setup or resource workers

primary_streaming_setup.name: canonical_camera_block_potential_normal_accumulation
primary_streaming_setup.construction: For each active camera in increasing integer camera-ID order, form only that camera's derivative-row vector response, solve the frozen zero-sum detector-potential KKT system for all affine basis columns, add the camera potential block transpose-times-block to G, and release camera-local dense arrays before the next camera.
primary_streaming_setup.normal_and_factor: Symmetrize the accumulated G, set lambda=(2^-8)^2*lambda_max(G), and retain only the NumPy-tril packed lower Cholesky factor of G+lambda I.

stage_a_setup_equivalence.algorithmic_live_dense_value_gate: For every setup, the reported camera-streamed accounted live dense value upper bound must be strictly below the corresponding global dense vector-response plus global potential-response plus rank-square normal value count. This is an algorithmic array-count gate, not an RSS measurement.
stage_a_setup_equivalence.independent_method: The validator does not import the v206 core. It uses a deterministic Helmert zero-mean basis and an SPD reduced solve for each camera, then an eigensystem solve for coordinates.
stage_a_setup_equivalence.pass_condition: All 26 factors and all 2626 coordinates pass every numerical, roster, source, seal, forbidden-array, value-count, permutation, and independent-comparison gate.

fresh_resource_gate.arm_order: Each three-arm block uses one of the six permutations in a deterministic shuffled Latin roster; workers are serial and every block is complete.
fresh_resource_gate.worker_self_rss_definition: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss converted to bytes as-is on macOS and multiplied by 1024 on Linux; this is a process high-water mark.
fresh_resource_gate.sampled_worker_tree_rss_definition: Maximum sampled RSS of the worker and recursive descendants; a lower bound at the frozen sampling interval.
fresh_resource_gate.sampled_controller_worker_pipeline_rss_d: Maximum sampled controller RSS plus worker-tree RSS without double-counting; a whole-pipeline lower bound at the frozen sampling interval.
fresh_resource_gate.decision_scope: A pass establishes only post-open all-nine resource headroom. It does not erase the extra A-transpose relative to dense K1 and cannot be called broad variable-cardinality success.

fixed_decision_order: Any input, source, seal, roster, finite, shape, KKT, factor, coordinate, permutation, forbidden-array, independent-method, worker, monitor, block, call-ledger, output-equivalence, or recomputation failure makes v206 inconclusive.
If stage A fails, conclude FAIL_STREAMING_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_SETUP_EQUIVALENCE_V206 and do not run the resource gate.
If stage A passes independently but any valid wall or RSS resource gate fails, record the exact failed dimensions and conclude FAIL_STREAMING_COMPACT_FRESH_RESOURCE_V206.
Only if stage A and every wall, RSS, call, monitor, block, and output gate pass under independent adjudication may conclude PASS_STREAMING_COMPACT_FRESH_RESOURCE_V206.
Even a pass leaves algorithm_breakthrough, external_generalization, curved_ray_validated, real_bost, and paper_success false.
failure_action: Do not tune block size, tau, camera order, detector integration, resource thresholds, repetitions, or arm roster after results. Do not rescue a valid failure with CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet or GPU training.
